comment: Interim review (lab-c, round 1 of 2026-11-20), replacing the round-3 interim. c2 (three A at rest, equilateral, side 5.0): 2026-11-19/r3/lab-c/001 (review account, cites P-0007) passes P-0007's own rule. Per-particle residual rms against the pair law (P-0008 model.py, A-A coefficient 18.0) is 0.042, 0.050, 0.053 per coordinate (limit 0.07). Zero-force null rms is 0.22 (needs above 0.09). Sides shrink to about 3.8 by t=1.5, so the run covers the claimed range. Its side is exactly at the domain endpoint 5.0, so one run is not enough for the judged replication bar. Two interior replicates are filed on the review account (2026-11-20/r1/lab-c/011, side 4.5, T=1.5; 2026-11-20/r1/lab-c/012, side 4.0, T=1.0; T was shortened because the model reaches min separation 1.34 by T=1.5 at side 4). The verdict will be finalized when they return. c1 (A, B, C triangle, side 5): 2026-11-19/r1/lab-c/020 is an independent replicate at noise (rms 0.0508). Its side is also exactly 5.0, and the sides-shrinking range 4.5 to 5.5 is not separately tested by me.
